_doc: Single source of truth for the island. Units are three.js world units, Y up, the camera looks from +Z towards -Z. x and z are ground coordinates, r is the radius of the plot. The Blender island script reads this file (Blender x = x, Blender y = -z). Monsters are about 1 unit tall. Grass is at y = 0; habitat floors and building plazas are 0.025 above it, and monsters stand on that floor.
